paragraph_text: (E5) (G.Baumslag, A.Miasnikov, V.Remeslennikov) Is a free product of two equationally noetherian groups equationally noetherian?  (A group is called equationally noetherian if every system of equations in this group is equivalent to a finite subsystem).  Background
